reason: A dsh provider plugin that connects the built-in web_search capability to Tavily for external web searches and result retrieval.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的内置 web_search 工具连接到 Tavily，以执行外部网页搜索并返回搜索结果。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness's built-in web_search tool to Tavily for external web searches and result retrieval.

capabilities: Sends web search queries to the Tavily API
Uses a configured Tavily API key for external service access
Returns Tavily search results and optional generated answers to the host web_search tool
Allows configuration of the Tavily endpoint and search parameters
